experiment: Experiment 13 NIPA: Native-path Intervention and Phenotype Attribution

interventions.G: Only ph_z[perm_G] in graph-similarity concatenation; real ph_z enters ph_unet
interventions.F: Native attention on real embeddings sets graph-loss weights; a second deterministic attention on ph_embed[perm_F] supplies classifier joint only
interventions.R: Only SITE_ID passed to the unchanged native RP builder is permuted; real training labels and original phenotype inputs preserved
interventions.G_F_mapping: Separate SHA256-derived private generators; partition x true-site derangement cycles; singletons fixed
interventions.R_mapping: Partition-local site-block circular shift by largest site count; label-blind exact site-count preservation and maximal site changes
interventions.N0: Unmodified core.forward, not the local wrapper

validation: Original validation CE + original graph regularizer; strict decrease saves best, equality resets stopping counter
formal_test: One native stochastic grad-enabled forward after restoring best weights and end-training RNG, ASD=0 probability
frozen_rng: SHA256(seed/fold/PCCI-repeat-base)[:15] modulo 2^32, same first three historical fixed draw definitions
statistics: Within-seed 10-fold means, then mean and sample SD over three repeated-CV seeds; paired descriptive comparisons, not 30 independent cohorts
factor_sign: Real-minus-null; positive ACC/BA/AUC and negative CE favor real
evidence_rule: Descriptive, not a significance test: formal real-minus-null AUC>0, BA>=0 and CE<0, each supported by at least two seeds, plus frozen AUC>0 and CE<0 each supported by at least two seeds and a nonzero target-path change. If no formal AUC/BA/CE direction supports real, Unsupported; otherwise Weak/Inconclusive. Retain every effect and uncertainty, no test-tuned thresholds.
limitations: Historical cross-fold supervised RFE leakage retained
Native VAE sampling, eval dropout, RP early return, unregistered weights, inplace constraints and detached attention weights retained
G/F null retains marginal phenotype information; N7 is not imaging-only
R uses training-label reward/penalty; not biological or unseen-site proof
